newsitem.title: USA: NY Gov offers $1 bln tax relief to localities.
newsitem.headline: NY Gov offers $1 bln tax relief to localities.

text.p: New York Gov. George Pataki, who has made cutting taxes a cornerstone of his Administration's program, said Friday he would offer a tax relief package of more than $1 billion for localities and taxpayers.
The Republican governor also called for a constitutional amendment provision to prevent the state from requiring localities to pay for unfunded programs.
The state's ability to impose unfunded mandates on local governments has been a big source of friction between them and Albany.
